# Published removal-bootstrap fixture

Exact public `tools/uninstall.sh` from source
`0250efeb87ff5f6c331a2d067c181a29084b37a2`, SHA256
`2ecda6be26438e3f6ffa46cc66c7f1c3b55ae1db6d176cf8471b4963724532f1`.
This is inert reference data, never executed. The public guide remains bound to
its published immutable URL; an unpublished developer helper must not silently
replace that download or its checksum. Tests verify the actual pinned bytes,
offline-installed/download positives and changed/candidate-byte refusals.
